name: Yukon Nominee Program (YNP)
description: Skilled-worker streams of the Yukon Nominee Program (YNP) and whether they run through Express Entry (an Express Entry-aligned nomination adds 600 CRS points).

attributes.legal_status: in force on the access date (provincial programme under a federal–provincial agreement)

skilled_worker_streams.summary: Employer-driven, TEER 0–3, at least 12 months' experience
In the federal pool; TEER 0–3 only

attributes.notes: Employer Expression of Interest intakes in 2026 ran 19–30 January and 6–17 July 2026; next opportunity expected in 2027. 2026 priorities: regulated health professionals, rural employers, Yukon University graduates, Francophone workers.
attributes.status_dependency: Eligibility depends on occupation (NOC/TEER), job offer, language scores and existing ties to the province — all unknown (USER-PROFILE.md; OPEN-QUESTIONS.md items 2, 4, 7).

sources.title: Learn about the Yukon Nominee Program process for 2026
Yukon Nominee Program 2026 Operational Guidance (updated 3 July 2026)

verification.notes: Read through search-engine extracts of the provincial programme's official pages, not fetched in full.

limitations: Stream rules change several times a year and intake is often by invitation only; read the provincial guide in force before applying.
